description: List the users who reacted to a message with one emoji, ordered by user ID. Returns users and next_after; pass it as after to get the next page, and stop when a page comes back empty. To add the bot's own reaction, use discord_add_my_message_reaction. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History. Read-only; safe to retry.

after.description: Get users after this user ID for forward pagination

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread holding the message

emoji.description: Emoji as a Unicode character ('👍') or its URL-encoded form ('%F0%9F%91%8D'), or a custom emoji as name:id ('party_blob:123456789012345678')

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return (1-100, defaults to 25)

message_id.description: ID of the message to target

type.description: Reaction type filter: 0 for normal reactions, 1 for burst (super) reactions (defaults to 0)

name: discord_list_message_reactions_by_emoji

anyOf.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
